title: Three loop QCD corrections to electroweak radiative parameters
summary: We reevaluate the vacuum polarization functions for electroweak gauge bosons at three loops in QCD, employing state-of-the-art perturbative techniques. We apply these results to determine the ${\mathcal{O}}(αα_s^2)$ corrections to the electroweak radiative parameters $Δρ$, $Δr$ and $Δκ$. We improve the accuracy of the calculation at this perturbative order, compared to the existing literature, and present some phenomenological implications of these results.
